Re: In Re: Deon D. Colvin, case no. 25A918, Resubmission of Renewal Application
That Was Originally Submitted on 2-27-26
Dear Mr. Harris:
Pursuant to Supreme Court Rule 22.4, Applicant respectfully requests that the application for
stay of the mandate, which was denied by Chief Justice Roberts on February 19, 2026 be
renewed and submitted to the Honorable Sonia Sotomayer, Associate Justice of the Supreme
Court. Applicant's renewal application is one that now requires the recall and stay of the
mandate, since the mandate was issued on the date of denial.
As required by Rule 22.4, I have enclosed ten (10) copies of the original application that was
denied. Proof of service on all parties is also attached.
Respectfully Submitted,
Deon D. Colvin (Applicant)
743 Fairmont Street NW #211
Washington, D.C. 20001
(216) 396-8512
